title: Observation
description: One figure, from one publisher, for one period. Observations are never edited after merge: a correction is a new observation that names the one it replaces in `supersedes`.

low.description: Lower end of an estimate's interval

high.description: Upper end of an estimate's interval

kind.description: count: a tally a named body recorded. claim: a figure a party states without a checkable method. estimate: a modeled number with an interval.

bound.description: How the publisher qualified the number: 'at least 1,760' is at_least, 'around 1,200' is approximate.

source.description: The body that produced the figure: an id from data/sources.json

publisher.description: Where the figure was read, which may be an outlet reporting the source

archive.description: Path under archive/ or a web.archive.org URL

quote.description: The exact sentence the figure appears in. Required for importer-added observations.

supersedes.description: id of the observation this one corrects
